plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Millersville University's official Coursedog catalog (catalog.millersville.edu); this plan's source_url is the program's official curriculum page. The live Undergraduate catalog page states: 'This publication is an announcement for the 2026-2027 academic year,' so this plan is filed under catalog year 2026-2027. The archived 2025-2026 catalog PDF's curriculum pages for these majors are blank, so the 2025-2026 tables could not be verified and were not used. The catalog publishes requirement tables only for this program: no official semester-by-semester sequence and no total degree credit figure appear on the program page, so this plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single requirements block, per the standing rule. The university-wide bachelor's minimum is 120 credits, including the Gateway General Education program (45-48 credits), which the program page does not itemize; the recorded total is the exact sum of the itemized major and required-related blocks transcribed here, not the 120-credit degree total. Coursedog display warning: each catalog block also shows a second 'Completion requirement' figure that in places disagrees with its block heading and row sums; headings and rows were transcribed as displayed and every disagreement affecting this plan is disclosed in these notes. 'Any X course(s)' pool rows on the catalog page show the summed credit value of the whole matching course pool, not a per-course credit; such blocks are recorded here as choice slots at the block's required credit amount. This is the RN-to-BSN completion program only: Millersville publishes no traditional pre-licensure BSN curriculum on this page. The program presupposes an associate degree or diploma in nursing. Major in Nursing (BSN) (61 credits) = Lower Division Nursing Credits 30 ('Upon confirmation of your Associates Degree, 30.0 credits will be awarded', recorded here as one 30-credit block entry; it is a catalog credit award, not a Millersville course) plus Required Nursing Courses 31 (nine courses, minimum grade C). NURS 421 is printed as 0-5 credits on the curriculum page and as 5 credits on its own catalog course-description page; NURS 478 is printed as 0-4 credits on the curriculum page and as 4 credits on its course-description page (senior capstone, 28 clinical hours); both are recorded at the course-description values, with which the 31-credit block reconciles exactly (3+3+3+4+5+3+3+4+3 = 31). The page's inner 'Requirements Fulfill all 0-5 cr' label is a Coursedog display error, disclosed here. Catalog note: students in the Accelerated BSN to MSN program may elect the 300/400 or 500 level equivalent course; only the 500-level course applies to the MSN. Required Related (3-4 credits): Statistics Requirement, recorded as MATH 130 Elements of Statistics 1 (3 credits); the printed alternative is MATH 234 Statistics for Health Sciences (4 credits). Recorded total: 61 + 3 = 64 credits.
